description: Defines a serializable struct MemoryMessageData used for representing in-memory queue events in Orleans streaming, including stream ID, sequence number, timestamps, and payload.

classes.name: MemoryMessageData
classes.description: A struct representing a message in Orleans in-memory streaming, including stream ID, sequence number, timestamps, and payload.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new MemoryMessageData instance with specified stream ID and payload, setting EnqueueTimeUtc to current UTC time.
